title: MVP V4-4 emergency routing and finalized account behavior
brief: Implement emergency routing activation and finalized account behavior: activation requires target account signature plus valid rescue-address cosign; missing rescue address or one signature rejects; activation finalizes account irreversibly; finalized account cannot spend/unstake/set arbitrary policies with the old key; incoming transfer to finalized account routes deterministically to rescue address or rejects under documented routing rules.

delegations.prompt_summary: Prepare reuse map for emergency routing activation, rescue cosign, finalized behavior, redirect apply path, risks and tests.
Implement emergency routing activation, rescue-address cosign validation, irreversible finalization, finalized account denies, and incoming transfer redirect to rescue.
Validate V4-4 emergency routing and finalized behavior with policy tests, targeted filters, cargo checks, and full pwm-core lib tests.
Add explicit no-mutation assertions to bad rescue cosign emergency activation test.
Retest bad rescue cosign no-mutation hardening.
Independent review of V4-4 emergency routing implementation and tests.
Auto-close PASS_WITH_NITS: add cross-domain rescue redirect deny test and keep V4-4 Transfer-only redirect docs aligned.
Retest cross-domain rescue redirect deny and full policy_ filter after V4-4 nit fix.
Final re-review after V4-4 docs and cross-domain rescue deny test closed PASS_WITH_NITS.

notes: Security-sensitive slice. Keep evaluator pure; apply path performs deterministic finalization/routing only after evaluator permits. Do not add organization registry or policy DSL. pwm-testing PASS: cargo check -p pwm-core, cargo check -p pwmd, cargo test -p pwm-core policy_ (19 passed), targeted emerg/finalized/rescue filters, cargo test -p pwm-core --lib (133 passed, 1 ignored). Follow-up gap closed: bad rescue cosign test now asserts no state mutation; retest PASS. Review PASS_WITH_NITS: docs clarified V4-4 redirect applies to incoming Transfer only and cross-domain rescue deny test was added; retest PASS with policy_ 20/20.
